forum.title: NUCLEO-C5A3ZG - Why is CAN not populated?
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
The STM32C5 FDCAN feature was decided to be on the [NUCLEO-C542RC | Product - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/nucleo-c542rc.html)

The NUCLEO-C5A3ZG was then made Ethernet focused, keeping the price in check.
forum.content_text: Hi, Could somebody please explain why CAN on the NUCLEO-C5A3ZG is not populated?
